audit_status.source_base: Greek Colossians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for thanksgiving, prayer, image of invisible Divine, firstborn, all things through/in/for Messiah, reconciliation, mystery, Messiah in you.

verses.restored: Paul, apostle of Messiah Jesus through the will of the Divine, and Timothy the sibling,

familiar.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

modern.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

original.text: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς

verses.restored: to the holy and trusting siblings in Messiah at Colossae: grace to you and peace from Divine our Father.

familiar.text: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father. Thanksgiving and Prayer (1 Corinthians 1:4–9; Philippians 1:3–11)

original.text: τοῖς ἐν ⸀Κολοσσαῖς ἁγίοις καὶ πιστοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ⸀ἡμῶν.

verses.restored: We give thanks to the Divine, Father of our Lord Jesus Messiah, always praying concerning you,

familiar.text: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

modern.text: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,

original.text: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ ⸀θεῷ πατρὶ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ πάντοτε ⸀περὶ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι,

verses.restored: having heard of your trust in Messiah Jesus and the love that you have toward all the holy ones,

familiar.text: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

modern.text: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—

original.text: ἀκούσαντες τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ⸂ἣν ἔχετε⸃ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους

verses.restored: because of the hope laid away for you in the heavens, which you heard before in the word of truth, the good news,

familiar.text: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

modern.text: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel

original.text: διὰ τὴν ἐλπίδα τὴν ἀποκειμένην ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ἣν προηκούσατε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῆς ἀληθείας τοῦ εὐαγγελίου

verses.restored: which has come to you, just as also in all the world it is bearing fruit and growing, as also among you from the day you heard and truly knew the grace of the Divine.

familiar.text: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

modern.text: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.

original.text: τοῦ παρόντος εἰς ὑμᾶς, καθὼς καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ ⸀κόσμῳ ἐστὶν καρποφορούμενον καὶ αὐξανόμενον καθὼς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ἀφʼ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐπέγνωτε τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ·

verses.restored: Just as you learned from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a trustworthy servant of Messiah on our behalf,

familiar.text: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

modern.text: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,

original.text: ⸀καθὼς ἐμάθετε ἀπὸ Ἐπαφρᾶ τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ συνδούλου ἡμῶν, ὅς ἐστιν πιστὸς ὑπὲρ ⸀ἡμῶν διάκονος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

verses.restored: who also made clear to us your love in Spirit.

familiar.text: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

modern.text: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.

original.text: ὁ καὶ δηλώσας ἡμῖν τὴν ὑμῶν ἀγάπην ἐν πνεύματι.

verses.restored: Because of this, from the day we heard, we also do not cease praying for you and asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding,

familiar.text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

modern.text: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

original.text: Διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς, ἀφʼ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσαμεν, οὐ παυόμεθα ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι καὶ αἰτούμενοι ἵνα πληρωθῆτε τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ συνέσει πνευματικῇ,

verses.restored: to walk worthily of the Lord into all pleasing, bearing fruit in every good work and growing in the knowledge of the Divine,

familiar.text: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

modern.text: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

original.text: ⸀περιπατῆσαι ἀξίως τοῦ κυρίου εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρεσκείαν ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ καρποφοροῦντες καὶ αὐξανόμενοι ⸂τῇ ἐπιγνώσει⸃ τοῦ θεοῦ,

verses.restored: being empowered with all power according to the strength of his glory, into all endurance and patience with joy,

familiar.text: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

modern.text: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully

original.text: ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει δυναμούμενοι κατὰ τὸ κράτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς πᾶσαν ὑπομονὴν καὶ μακροθυμίαν μετὰ χαρᾶς,

verses.restored: giving thanks to the Father, who made you sufficient for the share of the inheritance of the holy ones in light,

familiar.text: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

modern.text: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.

original.text: εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ πατρὶ τῷ ἱκανώσαντι ⸀ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν μερίδα τοῦ κλήρου τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ φωτί,

verses.restored: who rescued us from the authority of darkness and transferred us into the reign of the Son of his love,

familiar.text: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

modern.text: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,

original.text: ὃς ἐρρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ σκότους καὶ μετέστησεν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς ἀγάπης αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: in whom we have redemption/release, the forgiveness/release of sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

modern.text: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins. The Supremacy of the Son (Hebrews 1:1–14)

original.text: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν·

verses.restored: He is image of the invisible Divine, firstborn of all creation,

familiar.text: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

modern.text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

original.text: ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἀοράτου, πρωτότοκος πάσης κτίσεως,

verses.restored: because in him all things were created, in the heavens and upon the earth, the visible and the invisible, whether thrones or lordships or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through him and into him.

familiar.text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

modern.text: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.

original.text: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτίσθη τὰ ⸀πάντα ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ⸀καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὰ ὁρατὰ καὶ τὰ ἀόρατα, εἴτε θρόνοι εἴτε κυριότητες εἴτε ἀρχαὶ εἴτε ἐξουσίαι· τὰ πάντα διʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἔκτισται·

verses.restored: And he is before all things, and in him all things hold together.

familiar.text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

modern.text: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.

original.text: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν πρὸ πάντων καὶ τὰ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκεν,

verses.restored: And he is head of the body, the assembly; he is beginning, firstborn from the dead, so that he himself might come to be first in all things,

familiar.text: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

modern.text: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.

original.text: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ σώματος τῆς ἐκκλησίας· ὅς ⸀ἐστιν ἀρχή, πρωτότοκος ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, ἵνα γένηται ἐν πᾶσιν αὐτὸς πρωτεύων,

verses.restored: because in him all the fullness was pleased to dwell,

familiar.text: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

modern.text: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,

original.text: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ εὐδόκησεν πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα κατοικῆσαι

verses.restored: and through him to reconcile all things into himself, making peace through the blood of his cross, through him, whether things upon the earth or things in the heavens.

familiar.text: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

modern.text: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.

original.text: καὶ διʼ αὐτοῦ ἀποκαταλλάξαι τὰ πάντα εἰς αὐτόν, εἰρηνοποιήσας διὰ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ σταυροῦ αὐτοῦ, ⸂[διʼ αὐτοῦ]⸃ εἴτε τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἴτε τὰ ⸀ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς·

verses.restored: And you, once being alienated and hostile in mind by harmful works,

familiar.text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

modern.text: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.

original.text: καὶ ὑμᾶς ποτε ὄντας ἀπηλλοτριωμένους καὶ ἐχθροὺς τῇ διανοίᾳ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς πονηροῖς—

verses.restored: yet now he reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and blameless and unaccused before him,

familiar.text: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

modern.text: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—

original.text: νυνὶ δὲ ⸀ἀποκατηλλάγητε ἐν τῷ σώματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου— παραστῆσαι ὑμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους καὶ ἀνεγκλήτους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: if indeed you remain in the trust, founded and firm, and not moved away from the hope of the good news that you heard, proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, became servant.

familiar.text: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

modern.text: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant. Paul’s Suffering for the Church (2 Corinthians 11:16–33)

original.text: εἴ γε ἐπιμένετε τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε, τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν ⸀πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν, οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος.

verses.restored: Now I rejoice in sufferings on behalf of you, and I fill up what is lacking of the pressures of Messiah in my flesh, on behalf of his body, which is the assembly,

familiar.text: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:

modern.text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.

original.text: Νῦν χαίρω ἐν τοῖς παθήμασιν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀνταναπληρῶ τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν θλίψεων τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ὑπὲρ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἡ ἐκκλησία,

verses.restored: of which I became servant according to the stewardship/administration of the Divine given to me for you, to fulfill the word of the Divine,

familiar.text: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

modern.text: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,

original.text: ἧς ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ διάκονος κατὰ τὴν οἰκονομίαν τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς πληρῶσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ,

verses.restored: the mystery hidden from the ages and from the generations, but now made manifest to his holy ones,

familiar.text: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

modern.text: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.

original.text: τὸ μυστήριον τὸ ἀποκεκρυμμένον ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γενεῶν,— ⸀νῦν δὲ ἐφανερώθη τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: to whom the Divine willed to make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the nations: Messiah in you, the hope of glory.

familiar.text: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

modern.text: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

original.text: οἷς ἠθέλησεν ὁ θεὸς γνωρίσαι τί τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ⸀ὅ ἐστιν Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν, ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς δόξης·

verses.restored: Him we proclaim, warning every human and teaching every human in all wisdom, so that we may present every human complete/mature in Messiah.

familiar.text: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

modern.text: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.

original.text: ὃν ἡμεῖς καταγγέλλομεν νουθετοῦντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον καὶ διδάσκοντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ, ἵνα παραστήσωμεν πάντα ἄνθρωπον τέλειον ἐν ⸀Χριστῷ·

verses.restored: For this also I labor, struggling according to his working that works in me in power.

familiar.text: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

modern.text: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.

original.text: εἰς ὃ καὶ κοπιῶ ἀγωνιζόμενος κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν δυνάμει.

translation_notes: The Christ hymn is cosmic: Messiah is image, firstborn, creator-context, sustainer, head, fullness, and reconciler of all things.
Firstborn of all creation is rank/source/heir language within the hymn, not a reduction of Messiah to a created being.
Reconciliation is cosmic and embodied: peace through the cross, in the body of his flesh.
